evidence.note: Response answers a different AuthnRequest than the one the SP has pending; consistent with a second tab overwriting the stored request ID.
Same mismatch on the bearer confirmation.

output.fix: Stop keeping a single pending request ID per browser session. Store each outstanding AuthnRequest ID in a set or map keyed by ID (or by RelayState), with a short TTL of about 5 to 10 minutes. On the ACS, accept the response only if its InResponseTo matches one of those pending IDs. Then consume that ID so it can't be replayed. Keep signature validation, audience and recipient checks, and clock skew at 5 minutes or less. Don't skip the InResponseTo check or accept unsolicited responses to work around this.
